stem: Meena finds four objects on her study table at home: an iron nail, a plastic ruler, a copper wire, and a wooden pencil. She wants to know which object is made of a magnetic material. Which method will correctly tell her this?

options.text: She should check which object looks hard and shiny, because all shiny objects are magnetic.
She should bring a magnet near each object and see which one is attracted towards the magnet.
She should drop each object in water and see which one sinks, because sinking objects are magnetic.
She should rub each object with a cloth and see which one becomes warm, because warm objects are magnetic.

teacher.key_rationale: The reliable test for a magnetic material is whether a magnet attracts it; the iron nail is attracted to the magnet. Appearance, sinking in water, and warming by rubbing do not identify magnetic materials.
